name: Idioms
description: Everyday idiomatic expressions, similes and proverbs, their meanings, register and use in natural English.

passages.title: The Surprise Test
passages.content:
On Monday our teacher gave us a surprise test, and I was completely (1) ______ the dark: I had not opened the book all weekend. My friend said the questions were a (2) ______ of cake, but for me they were very hard.

I tried my best, but I knew I had (3) ______ the boat. When I got the result, I decided to turn over a new (4) ______ and study every day. From now on, I will keep my (5) ______ on the ball in class.

passages.title: Opening Night
passages.content:
On the day of the school play everyone was nervous. Our director told us to 'break a (1) ______', which confused the younger actors until she explained that it meant 'good luck'. Just before the curtain rose, the main actor lost his voice, and we were all at our (2) ______ end.

Luckily, his understudy knew the part (3) ______ heart. The performance went off without a (4) ______, and the audience gave us a standing ovation. Our director said that we had all passed with flying (5) ______.

passages.title: The Price of a New Phone
passages.content:
My cousin wanted the latest phone, but it cost an (1) ______ and a leg. His parents said no, so he decided to save up. He worked at a café every weekend and kept his (2) ______ to the grindstone for six months.

Then, out of the (3) ______, his old phone started working perfectly again. He decided to (4) ______ it a day and keep the money for university instead. 'It was a blessing in (5) ______,' he told me.

passages.title: A Tale of Two Neighbours
passages.content:
For years the two neighbours did not see eye to (1) ______ about anything, from parking spaces to noisy dogs. Then one winter a storm brought down a tree between their houses. Instead of arguing, they decided to bury the (2) ______ and cut it up together.

Working side by side, they discovered that they had a lot in (3) ______. By spring they were as thick as (4) ______, and their families even went on holiday together. 'Sometimes it takes a disaster to (5) ______ the ice,' one of them joked.

questions.title: What does 'to be over the moon' mean?
questions.explanation: «Over the moon» означає бути надзвичайно щасливим.

questions.title: What does 'once in a blue moon' mean?
questions.explanation: «Once in a blue moon» означає дуже рідко.

questions.title: What does 'to break the ice' mean?
options: to make people feel relaxed at the start
to cancel a plan at the last minute
to lose your temper in public
to spoil a surprise for someone
questions.explanation: «Break the ice» означає розрядити обстановку на початку знайомства.

questions.title: What does 'a piece of cake' mean?
questions.explanation: «A piece of cake» означає щось дуже легке.

questions.title: What does 'to cost an arm and a leg' mean?
questions.explanation: «Cost an arm and a leg» означає коштувати дуже дорого.

questions.title: What does 'under the weather' mean?
questions.explanation: «Under the weather» означає почуватися недобре.

questions.title: Complete the simile: as cool as a ___.
questions.explanation: «As cool as a cucumber» означає незворушний.

questions.title: Complete the simile: as light as a ___.
questions.explanation: «As light as a feather» означає дуже легкий.

questions.title: What does 'to hit the books' mean?
questions.explanation: «Hit the books» означає взятися за навчання.

questions.title: What does 'to be in the same boat' mean?
options: to be in the same difficult situation
questions.explanation: «In the same boat» означає бути в однаковому скрутному становищі.

questions.title: What does 'to keep an eye on something' mean?
questions.explanation: «Keep an eye on» означає пильно стежити.

questions.title: What does 'to feel blue' mean?
questions.explanation: «Feel blue» означає почуватися сумно.

questions.title: What does 'to give somebody a hand' mean?
questions.explanation: «Give somebody a hand» означає допомогти.

questions.title: Match each idiom about anger or mood with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Ці ідіоми описують емоційний стан через образ.

questions.title: Match each body-part idiom with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Ідіоми з назвами частин тіла — один із найпоширеніших типів.

questions.title: Match each simile with the quality it describes.
questions.explanation: Сталі порівняння незмінні: тварину чи предмет замінити не можна.

questions.title: Match each weather idiom with its meaning.
pairs: it never rains but it pours
questions.explanation: Ідіоми про погоду часто описують життєві труднощі.

questions.title: Match each idiom with the situation where you would use it.
pairs: wishing somebody luck before a performance
hit the nail on the head
let the cat out of the bag
questions.explanation: Кожна ідіома доречна у своїй ситуації.

questions.title: What does 'to be a blessing in disguise' mean?
options: something bad that turns out well
something too good to be true
questions.explanation: «A blessing in disguise» означає лихо, що обернулося на добро.

questions.title: What does 'to sit on the fence' mean?
questions.explanation: «Sit on the fence» означає ухилятися від вибору сторони.

questions.title: What does 'to jump on the bandwagon' mean?
options: to join something that has become popular
questions.explanation: «Jump on the bandwagon» означає приєднатися до того, що стало модним.

questions.title: What does 'to bite off more than you can chew' mean?
questions.explanation: «Bite off more than you can chew» означає взятися за непосильне.

questions.title: What does 'to take something with a pinch of salt' mean?
questions.explanation: «Take with a pinch of salt» означає ставитися з недовірою.

questions.title: What does 'to be out of the woods' mean?
options: to be past the worst of a difficulty
to be lost in the countryside
questions.explanation: «Out of the woods» означає, що найгірше позаду.

questions.title: What does 'to burn the midnight oil' mean?
options: to work late into the night
questions.explanation: «Burn the midnight oil» означає працювати допізна.

questions.title: What does 'to cut corners' mean?
options: to do something cheaply or carelessly
to reduce the size of a room
questions.explanation: «Cut corners» означає робити абияк заради економії часу чи грошей.

questions.title: What does 'the tip of the iceberg' mean?
options: a small visible part of a much larger problem
the coldest place in a country
the final stage of a long project
the best example of a whole group
questions.explanation: «The tip of the iceberg» означає видиму частину значно більшої проблеми.

questions.title: What does 'to get cold feet' mean?
options: to lose your nerve before doing something
questions.explanation: «Get cold feet» означає злякатися в останню мить.

questions.title: What does 'to beat about the bush' mean?
questions.explanation: «Beat about the bush» означає говорити натяками замість прямо.

questions.title: What does 'to be on the same wavelength' mean?
options: to live in the same area
questions.explanation: «On the same wavelength» означає розуміти одне одного з півслова.

questions.title: Match each conversational idiom with what it means.
questions.explanation: Ці ідіоми часто трапляються в розмові й мають цілісне значення.

questions.title: Match each money idiom with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Ідіоми про гроші описують фінансове становище образно.

questions.title: Match each idiom about time with its meaning.
pairs: having ideas people are not ready for
fill a wait with something trivial
questions.explanation: Ідіоми про час описують поспіх, очікування або випередження.

questions.title: Match each idiom with the register in which it is used.
questions.explanation: Одна ідея може мати кілька ідіом різного регістру.

questions.title: Match each proverb with the advice it gives.
pairs: Do not judge a book by its cover.
questions.explanation: Прислів'я формулюють життєве правило стисло й образно.

questions.title: Match each idiom with the emotion it expresses.
pairs: at the end of your tether
questions.explanation: Кожна ідіома точно називає свій емоційний стан.

questions.title: What does 'to move the goalposts' mean?
options: to change the rules unfairly during a process
to postpone a decision until later
to reorganise a team before a match
to lower expectations before a result
questions.explanation: «Move the goalposts» означає змінювати правила посеред процесу.

questions.title: What does 'to paper over the cracks' mean?
options: to hide problems instead of solving them
questions.explanation: «Paper over the cracks» означає приховувати проблеми замість розв'язувати.

questions.title: What does 'a double-edged sword' describe?
options: something with both advantages and disadvantages
a dangerous weapon used in a fight
an unfair contest between two sides
a mistake that is repeated often
questions.explanation: «A double-edged sword» означає щось із перевагами й недоліками водночас.

questions.title: What does 'to throw the baby out with the bathwater' mean?
options: to discard something valuable while getting rid of what is unwanted
to act far too slowly in an emergency
to waste a lot of money on trivial things
to blame the wrong person for a failure
questions.explanation: «Throw the baby out with the bathwater» означає позбутися цінного разом із непотрібним.

questions.title: Match each idiom used in argument with its function.
questions.explanation: Ці звороти виконують в аргументації чіткі логічні функції.

questions.title: Match each political or media idiom with its meaning.
pairs: an opportunity likely to bring trouble
questions.explanation: Політичні й медійні ідіоми мають усталене значення в публіцистиці.

questions.title: Match each idiom with the nuance that separates it from its neighbours.
pairs: reveal a set of tangled difficulties
questions.explanation: Ці ідіоми описують різні способи потрапити в халепу.

questions.title: Match each idiom with the type of text where it fits best.
pairs: at the end of the day
to cut a long story short
questions.explanation: Ідіоми з тим самим значенням належать до різних регістрів.

questions.title: Match each idiom about risk with its meaning.
pairs: put all your eggs in one basket
reduce risk by keeping options open
questions.explanation: Ідіоми про ризик: класти всі яйця в один кошик — покластися на єдиний варіант, hedge your bets — лишити запасні варіанти.

questions.title: The Surprise Test — gap 1
questions.explanation: Be in the dark — «нічого не знати про щось».

questions.title: The Surprise Test — gap 2
questions.explanation: A piece of cake — «дуже легко».

questions.title: The Surprise Test — gap 3
questions.explanation: Miss the boat — «проґавити нагоду».

questions.title: The Surprise Test — gap 4
questions.explanation: Turn over a new leaf — «почати з чистого аркуша».

questions.title: The Surprise Test — gap 5
questions.explanation: Keep one's eye on the ball — «бути уважним і зосередженим».

questions.title: Opening Night — gap 1
questions.explanation: Break a leg — побажання успіху перед виступом.

questions.title: Opening Night — gap 2
questions.explanation: Be at one's wits' end — «не знати, що робити».

questions.title: Opening Night — gap 3
questions.explanation: Know something by heart — «знати напам'ять».

questions.title: Opening Night — gap 4
questions.explanation: Go off without a hitch — «пройти без жодної заминки».

questions.title: Opening Night — gap 5
questions.explanation: Pass with flying colours — «блискуче впоратися».

questions.title: The Price of a New Phone — gap 1
questions.explanation: Cost an arm and a leg — «коштувати шалених грошей».

questions.title: The Price of a New Phone — gap 2
questions.explanation: Keep one's nose to the grindstone — «важко й наполегливо працювати».

questions.title: The Price of a New Phone — gap 3
questions.explanation: Out of the blue — «несподівано».

questions.title: The Price of a New Phone — gap 4
questions.explanation: Call it a day — «на цьому зупинитися».

questions.title: The Price of a New Phone — gap 5
questions.explanation: A blessing in disguise — «не було б щастя, та нещастя допомогло».

questions.title: A Tale of Two Neighbours — gap 1
questions.explanation: See eye to eye — «сходитися в поглядах».

questions.title: A Tale of Two Neighbours — gap 2
questions.explanation: Bury the hatchet — «помиритися».

questions.title: A Tale of Two Neighbours — gap 3
questions.explanation: Have a lot in common — «мати багато спільного».

questions.title: A Tale of Two Neighbours — gap 4
questions.explanation: As thick as thieves — «нерозлийвода».

questions.title: A Tale of Two Neighbours — gap 5
questions.explanation: Break the ice — «розрядити обстановку, почати спілкування».
